sourceFindings: Production inventory grants now reuse the bounded package-private SQL helper. Existing permit, endpoint, database, locked-marker and runtime principal guards retain their ordering.
Only the inventory role gets marker UPDATE(singleton), after marker REVOKE ALL. Workflow common grants remain SELECT-only and no production DDL/adapter was changed.
V001 retains BOOLEAN singleton PRIMARY KEY with CHECK TRUE; marker provenance fields receive no UPDATE grant. Shared helper rejects reserved and injected role identifiers.

The unexecuted real lane seeds prior broad and direct-column grants only in newly created run-owned state, reapplies the production SQL, checks effective rights, expects exact42501 for zero-row denied operations,23514 for FALSE and23502 for NULL, and checks marker/witness preservation.
Real lane target is numeric loopback/PostgreSQL18 only. Existing database/role names are refused, live creation flags bound cleanup, and no force drop/CASCADE/backend termination is used.
Local SET ROLE and always-miss PostgresOnlyCache are explicitly not Entra or Redis proof; the real lane is named outside default Surefire Test patterns.
